site_name: Viettel High-Tech Data Center and R&D Hub (Tan Phu Trung)
town: Tan Phu Trung Industrial Park, Cu Chi
notes: Groundbreaking 23 Apr 2025; about 4 ha, about 10,000 racks; 140MW design power (IT vs total not stated). Billed as Vietnam's first 100MW+ data centre. The Investor (6 Nov 2025) reports operations from Q1 2026 and full completion before 2030; whether phase 1 is live by Nov 2026 not confirmed in sources opened, so left as Under construction. Capex not disclosed. Coordinates: Baxtel Viettel IDC Tan Phu Trung campus point (https://baxtel.com/campus/viettel-idc-tan-phu-trung-campus), used as the industrial park point. Hanoi Times: Uptime Tier III design, average 10kW racks, some up to 60kW for AI; Viettel's 16th DC; phase 1 due Q1 2026.

Inaugurated 10 Apr 2024; 30MW, more than 2,400 racks; Viettel's 14th data centre. Viettel network total then 87MW, 11,500 racks. Viettel planned VND10tn (US$401m) to reach 17,000 racks by 2025 and VND40tn for 34,000 racks by 2030. Viettel AI put Vietnam's first Nvidia DGX B200 (8 Blackwell GPUs) into operation at its Hoa Lac technical centre on 6 Feb 2026 (VOV).

Inaugurated 20 Aug 2025; 10,000 m2 over eight floors, 3,600 racks; FPT called it Vietnam's largest. FPT's fourth large DC (HN01, HN02, HCM01, HCM02; over 7,000 racks combined). MW and capex not disclosed. FPT is a private listed Vietnamese group (foreign shareholders not checked).

Saigon Hi-Tech Park board approved investment end-June 2025; over US$250m; starts at 30MW, expandable to 120MW (120 shown as full build). No operation date stated. Samsung C&T signed an MoU in Seoul (w.media 14 Aug 2025) to invest in and build the same HCMC High-Tech Park hyperscale DC: about US$1bn total, phase 1 30MW at US$250m, later phases above 100MW combined. MoU stage for Samsung.

operator: Kinh Bac City Development (KBC) with Accelerated Infrastructure Capital (AIC)
town: Tan Phu Trung Industrial Park, Cu Chi
notes: MoU with VietinBank 28 Oct 2025: about 10 ha, up to 200MW IT, around 100,000 GPUs, nearly US$2bn (The Investor 6 Nov 2025). MoU with HCMC Dept of Science and Technology 11 Mar 2026: about US$2.1bn, phase 1 up to 50MW (about 28,000 GPUs per ITPC/Bizhub), construction due to start 30 Apr 2026, phase 1 online by end-2027 (W.Media 12 Mar 2026). Investment registration certificate received 21 Jul 2026 (VNA/VietnamPlus 28 Aug 2026). AIC described as London and Hong Kong-based. Construction start not confirmed in sources opened. year_live = phase 1 target. Coordinates: Baxtel Viettel IDC Tan Phu Trung campus point (https://baxtel.com/campus/viettel-idc-tan-phu-trung-campus), used as the industrial park point.

site_name: STT VNG Ho Chi Minh City 1
operator: ST Telemedia Global Data Centres (STT GDC) and VNG
town: Tan Thuan Export Processing Zone, District 7
notes: 9.6MW IT, Uptime Tier III. Opening year not stated in source opened. VNG described as Tencent-invested; stake size not given, so Chinese capital link is indirect. Baxtel lists year built 2021, PUE 1.5. STT GDC says HCMC1 continues operating after its Aug 2026 exit from HCMC2.

site_name: STT VNG Ho Chi Minh City 2
operator: ST Telemedia Global Data Centres (STT GDC) and VNG
town: Tan Thuan Export Processing Zone, District 7
notes: JV agreed 15 May 2024 for up to 60MW IT on a 25,465 m2 site in Tan Thuan EPZ, first targeted H1 2026 (The Investor 16 May 2024). Baxtel 21 Aug 2026: STT GDC exiting; VNG to buy STT's 65% of site owner VTH for VND480bn (about US$18.3m); lease to Sep 2041 too short for hyperscale; VNG plans offices and e-sports use. Deal reported as pending. Treated as cancelled as a data centre.

site_name: G42-FPT-VinaCapital-Viet Thai hyperscale AI data center
operator: G42 with FPT and Viet Thai Group
owner_investors: G42; FPT; VinaCapital; Viet Thai Group
notes: Proposal to PM Pham Minh Chinh reported Jul 2025 (Reuters also reported): US$2bn AI factory. G42 shareholders include a UAE sovereign fund and Microsoft. Framework agreement signed 9 Feb 2026 by FPT/Viet Thai consortium and G42 with consumption commitments up to US$1bn (theinvestor.vn d18355); no MW, site or timeline.

operator: Evolution Data Centres (with Hathor and Frontier)
owner_investors: Evolution Data Centres; Hathor; Frontier (Evolution backers include Warburg Pincus and Abu Dhabi's Zero Two)
notes: Investment certificate issued 2026 (Technode says March; Bizhub says late April); People's Committee decision 19 Aug 2026 leases about 4.96 ha for 50 years from 30 Mar 2026 without auction. 52MW IT, over US$508m. One of the first fully foreign-owned hyperscale licences after the Telecom Law opening. Construction start not stated. W.Media (27 Aug 2026): 49,554 m2 parcel, US$508.7m, ready-for-service Q4 2027 per Evolution's website; Evolution formed a JV with HTC International Telecommunication in Dec 2025 for AI/hyperscale DCs in HCMC and Hanoi (https://w.media/evolution-leases-50000-sqm-land-to-build-52mw-data-center-in-ho-chi-minh-city/).

operator: Starmason JSC (Sembcorp Development and BB Holdings JV)
notes: Investment registration certificate late April 2026; 60MW IT; over US$480m. Bizhub/ITPC group it under SHTP approvals but do not name the park per project, so location is inferred. BB Holdings nationality not stated.

operator: NTT Global Data Centers HCMC1 LLC (NTT GDC and QD.TEK JV)
notes: JV announced 29 Mar 2022; 6MW critical IT load, five storeys, 3,100 m2 server rooms; target opening 2024. Actual opening not confirmed in sources opened, so kept at Announced. VietnamPlus (28 Aug 2026) lists NTT GDC among SHTP data centre investors.

General availability 19 Jun 2026; zone ID ap-southeast-1-han-1a (tied to Singapore region). EC2 C7i/M7i/R7i, EBS, S3 One Zone-IA, ECS/EKS, Direct Connect. A Local Zone, not a full region; host facility not disclosed.

Reuters-sourced report (Aug 2024) that Google was weighing its first Vietnam hyperscale DC near HCMC, possibly live by 2027; internal discussions only, Google declined to comment (DCD). No confirmation found in sources opened through Nov 2026. JLL cost guide in article: 50MW hyperscale DC in Vietnam US$300m to 650m.

Huawei said it was considering long-term DC investment in Vietnam and would proceed once demand reaches a critical threshold; needs at least three availability zones 30 km apart. No site, amount or commitment. Only Chinese hyperscaler DC plan found in sources opened.

site_name: VNPT-LG CNS hyperscale AI data center (MoU)
owner_investors: VNPT; LG CNS; Korea Investment Real Asset Management
notes: MoU at Korea-Vietnam Business Forum in Seoul, Aug 2025; joint technical working group. No site, MW, capex or timeline. Secondary trade site; treat as MoU only.

Initiation ceremony 28 Aug 2025; at least 10MW power load; US$200m total, US$20m first phase; construction planned from early 2026 (not confirmed started). Billed as Da Nang's first international high-tech DC project.

site_name: Vietnam Data Gen AI data center network (phase 1 Da Nang)
operator: Vietnam Data Gen (Create Capital Vietnam and Haimaker.ai JV)
notes: Announced 29 Dec 2025; about US$1bn for a 100MW network: phase 1 10 to 20MW in Da Nang Hi-Tech Park (US$100m to 200m), phase 2 40 to 60MW, later sites unnamed. No dates. Small listed developer; treat as aspirational.

town: Hoa Lac Hi-tech Park, Thach That
notes: VNPT's 8th DC; up to 2,000 racks, up to 23,000 m2; Uptime Tier III design and construction certified. Opening year not stated in Hanoi Times or DCD pages opened (DCD says launch announced 'this week'), so year_live left blank. MW not disclosed.

town: Tan Thuan Export Processing Zone, District 7
notes: Inaugurated mid-Aug 2022; 1,200 racks; US$64m (VND1.5tn). MW not stated. CMC says it was the first Vietnamese DC with two Uptime Tier III certifications (cmc.com.vn, Jul 2022).

anchor_tenant: FPT Cloud GPU customers (domestic and Japan)
notes: FPT (6 Dec 2024): thousands of Nvidia H100 GPUs, services from Jan 2025, data kept in Vietnam; host DC and city not disclosed. Capex = US$200m in FPT-Nvidia MoU (23 Apr 2024, The Investor). Flopper.io/Epoch estimate about 3,000 H100s and 4.2MW (model-based, not company figures, so MW left blank). Stack = US because the compute is Nvidia; the operator is Vietnamese. Anchor tenant field is generic, not a named customer.

Baxtel: Hong Kong PE manager bought a 6,056 m2 greenfield plot in SHTP (news dated 14 Jun 2022, headline 20MW); listed as planned for 2027. DCD's VNPT article also mentions a 20MW Gaw facility under development in HCMC. Hong Kong capital: listed as a Chinese-linked (Hong Kong) investor, not mainland state-backed. No construction confirmation found.

site_name: HITC EcoDC Hoa Lac expansion (Evolution JV)
operator: HITC (HTC International Telecommunication) and Evolution Data Centres
notes: JV signed 9 Dec 2025 to expand HITC's existing EcoDC in Hoa Lac and build a new HCMC hyperscale DC (the HCMC one appears to be Evolution DC VN HCMC; not stated explicitly). No MW, capex or dates.

Only a passing mention: VietNamNet (30 Aug 2024) says Alibaba was reportedly considering a Vietnam data centre in May 2024 to comply with local data storage rules. No primary confirmation, site or amount found. Included so Chinese hyperscaler presence is visible; treat as unconfirmed.
